defect: The new ProjectCoefficientGlobalL2 methods solve with the rank-local SparseMatrix a.SpMat() and the unassembled local linear form via a serial CG, so in parallel the L2 projection is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these new lines with FormLinearSystem, a parallel CG and RecoverFEMSolution; using SpMat of a ParBilinearForm in a serial solver is visibly wrong in the diff.

defect: The new SetMAA calls KINSetMAA on sundials_mem after KINInit (done in SetOperator), when KINSOL requires maa before KINInit, and on a null sundials_mem if called before SetOperator.
reason: The fix stores maa and applies it before KINInit in SetOperator; the ordering requirement and where KINInit happens are not visible in the added wrapper alone.

defect: In ComputeGradientBlocked the change writes doftrans[s] inside the j,l loops where s is not declared, a compile error (and the wrong transformation index).
reason: The fix titled fix compile error replaces doftrans[s] with TransformDual(doftrans[j], doftrans[l], ...); the out-of-scope s is visible in the diff.

defect: In the new Setup by_max_size branch, nhigh = ceil(pow(nmax - nel, 1.0/dim)) takes a root of a negative number when nmax <= nel, and size is read uninitialized in if (size != size_low) when the bisection loop does not run.
reason: Both fixed lines come from this initial commit and the uninitialized read and the negative pow argument can be seen in the new code.

defect: The change turns the if/else into a conditional expression whose operands are GetGhostDofs (returns void) and GetEntityDofs (returns int), which is ill-formed C++ and does not compile.
reason: The fix restores the if/else; the mismatched return types are only visible in fespace.hpp/pfespace.hpp.

defect: Set{Par,Serial}DiscreteTargetSpec now set meta info and the initial field only when adapt_eval is NULL, so a user-supplied evaluator (SetAdaptivityEvaluator) or a repeated call never gets its mesh/initial field set; the old code refreshed ts_nodes on every call.
reason: The fix removes this NULL guard so SetMetaInfo/SetInitialField always run (and frees the old mesh/fes); seeing that a non-NULL evaluator can come from SetAdaptivityEvaluator needs the header.

defect: The simplified GetValues/GetVectorValues call GetValue/GetVectorValue without T.SetIntPoint(&ip) (needed by CalcPhysShape/CalcVShape), and GetVectorValues hands a vdim-sized column reference to GetVectorValue, which resizes it to spaceDim.
reason: The fix, made the same day after unit tests failed, adds T.SetIntPoint and replaces GetColumnReference with SetCol in exactly these new lines.

defect: For an H1 trial space the new MixedCurlIntegrator sizes curlshape (dim*dof x 1) and uses GradToCurl, which is the curl of a vector field, instead of the rotated gradient GradToVectorCurl2D (dof x dim) of a scalar field.
reason: The fix changes exactly these two lines; telling GradToCurl and GradToVectorCurl2D apart needs densemat.

defect: Replacing (complex<double>) zi with (complex<real_t>) zi makes complex<float> * double (yn returns double) and double + complex<float> have no matching operator, so ex25 does not compile in single precision; the old complex<double> form did.
reason: The fix for building examples in single precision rewrites these exact lines with real_t casts; the type mismatch can be seen in the diff.

defect: The change puts MFEM_ABORT("TODO: s?") into the four-point Point constructor, so every construction of a face-center point (isotropic quad/hex refinement paths) aborts.
reason: The fix titled Fixed unit tests removes the abort and the unused s parameter; an unconditional abort in a used constructor can be seen in the diff.

defect: The new ParallelTestProblem passes int row_starts/col_starts arrays and SparseMatrix int J to HypreParMatrix constructors that expect HYPRE_Int, so the unit test does not compile with HYPRE big-int.
reason: The fix changes these added arrays to HYPRE_Int and copies J; the HYPRE_Int signature is in hypre.hpp, not in this diff.

defect: The new BuildVertexList indexes vertex_list.conforming[nd.vert_index] without checking vert_index >= 0, calls ElementSharesVertex for such nodes, and resizes conforming up front, which leaves default entries for unvisited slots.
reason: The fix guards index >= 0, deduplicates with processed_vertices and push_backs instead; that ghost nodes can have a negative vert_index is ParNCMesh behaviour outside the diff.

defect: The change switches the faces whose normal sign is flipped in GetSigns from face_id 0,3,4 to 0,1,4, which gives wrong normal signs on hex faces 1 and 3.
reason: The same-day fix Fix sign errors in normal computation reverts exactly this edit; which faces need flipping depends on the hex face orientation tables.

defect: num_neighbor_elems = GetNFaceNeighborElements() is read before ExchangeFaceNbrData(), so it can be 0 or stale and x_shared gets the wrong size for the MPI_Irecv into it (buffer overflow).
reason: The fix moves that line after ExchangeFaceNbrData and adds size assertions; knowing the count depends on the exchange needs pmesh.

defect: In PrintAsOne the attribute index j is reused as the vertex loop counter and incremented once per rank rather than per element, so wrong attributes are printed (and the array can be read out of bounds); attributes are also sent under if (ne) instead of if (nc).
reason: The same-day fix introduces a separate counter m incremented per element and fixes the send guard; the clobbered j can be seen in the diff.

defect: When an edge is already set, pkv_map[pkv] = pkv_map[pkv_other] overwrites any earlier link of pkv instead of uniting the two sets, so knot vectors linked through several edges are not merged.
reason: The same-day fix replaces this assignment with a proper union-find unite(); an overwrite where a union is needed is visible, and the author's own comment shows doubt.

defect: The new DataCollectionToFmsDataCollection builds hex (and tet) faces from hand-written edge orders that do not follow MFEM's element edge/face ordering, lacks a break after the TETRAHEDRON case so it falls through to the hex code, and divides the triangle count by 4.
reason: Before this change the function was a stub, and the fix Fix face ordering on hexes rewrites this new code to use GetEdgeVertices; the fall-through and the /4 are visible.

defect: GetFullAssemblySparseMatrix allocates the CSR I array with size entries instead of size+1, so h_I[ndofs] and the shift loop write past the end.
reason: The fix changes New(size) to New(size+1) on the line this change added.

defect: The fix guards &data[0]/&data[vsize] against a null data pointer on empty MPI ranks throughout complex_fem.cpp.
reason: The pointer pattern already existed in the original constructors and Update methods, and the constructors this change added were rewritten (a3121c8) before the fix, so the fixed lines are not this change's.

defect: The new miniapp does not compile: ector typo, a trailing comma in a parameter list, the undeclared speed and mesh, dudt used under the name du_dt, an ODE(a) call against a two-argument constructor, and a Step with the wrong arity.
reason: The fix corrects these lines of the newly added file, and the syntax errors can be seen in the diff.

defect: The new k1/k2 formulas for the triangle face DoF orientations (1,0,2) and (2,0,1) use 2*pm1 where 2*pm2 is needed, giving wrong or out-of-range indices (for p=2 they yield 2,3 on a 2-DoF face).
reason: The fix changes pm1 to pm2 in exactly these two added lines, and a p=2 check on the diff shows the overflow.

defect: PA.C0.HostWrite() is hoisted before PA.C0.SetSize(...), which reallocates, so the following host writes to C0(0) happen without a valid host-write flag and the device copy can be stale.
reason: The same-day fix moves HostWrite back after each SetSize; calling HostWrite before a reallocating SetSize is visibly wrong.

defect: In FGMRES the new monitor update calls Update(x_monitor, i, H, s, v) with the Krylov basis v instead of the preconditioned directions z, so the updated solution handed to the monitor is wrong.
reason: The fix changes v to z; the very next Update call in the diff uses z.

defect: FECollection::NewL2(order+1, dim, mesh->NURBSext) dereferences mesh after delete mesh, a use-after-free.
reason: The fix changes mesh to pmesh, and the delete mesh is a few lines above in the same diff.

defect: The MFEM_USE_ALGOIM guard is closed right after the include, so the class using blitz::TinyVector and Algoim types is compiled without Algoim and the build fails (CMake builds integ_algoim.cpp unconditionally).
reason: The fix moves the #endif to the end of the file; that blitz types are used outside the guard can be seen in the new file.

defect: The pyramid branch of Make3D adds nx*nx*nz center vertices instead of nx*ny*nz and uses the center vertex VTXP(x, y+1, z+1) instead of VTXP(x, y, z), so the vertex count and pyramid connectivity are wrong.
reason: The fix changes exactly these two added lines, and the typos can be seen against the surrounding loops.

defect: AddMult now takes the cuSPARSE branch when useCuSparse is set (on by default) without checking that a CUDA device is active, so CPU runs go into the cuSPARSE/empty branch and skip the CPU SpMV.
reason: The same-day fix restores the Device::Allows(CUDA_MASK) check; the dropped device condition can be seen in the diff.

defect: NonconformingTransposeInterpolation now loops over num_nc_faces but still indexes d_x with the loop index as a face number instead of conf.face_index, so it interpolates the wrong faces.
reason: The fix uses nc_face and conf.face_index, as the forward NonconformingInterpolation in the same diff already does.

defect: The new InitBasisWithIndices takes the element from indices[0] for the key but builds the basis with InitTensorBasis/InitNonTensorBasis, which use fes.GetFE(0), so mixed meshes get the wrong basis.
reason: The function is new in this change (absent from the parent), and the fix adds WithIndices helpers that use GetFE(indices[0]); the mismatch can be seen in the new file.

defect: The new GetFaceDofsLex maps 3D hex faces 0 (bottom), 1 (south) and 4 (west) in plain lexicographic order, which does not match the faces' outward-oriented reference ordering, so face DoFs and normals come out flipped.
reason: The fix Fix normal orientation in 3D reverses the i index for exactly these faces in maps this change created; which faces need reversing depends on the hex face orientation convention outside the diff.

defect: The base BilinearFormIntegrator::AssembleTraceFaceMatrix is defined with an extra test_fe2 parameter that matches neither its declaration nor the overrides added in the same change, so it fails to compile or does not override.
reason: The same-day fix fix wrong signature removes test_fe2, and the mismatch with the derived definitions can be seen in the diff.

defect: MixedScalarVectorIntegrator now tests vec_fe->GetVDim() == 2 for cross_2d; for gradient-based integrators vec_fe is a scalar H1 element (VDim 1), so the 2D cross rotation is skipped and the result is wrong.
reason: The fix uses the integrator's vdim = GetVDim(*vec_fe), which those subclasses override to GetDim(); seeing this needs bilininteg.hpp.

defect: The change flips the 9th ND_FuentesPyramidElement tangent from (-1/sqrt2, -1/sqrt2, sqrt2) to (+1/sqrt2, +1/sqrt2, sqrt2), giving the wrong direction for the interior Nedelec DoFs.
reason: The fix Fixing direction used for interior Nedelec DoFs restores the negative signs; which direction is right depends on the pyramid basis definition.

defect: The new ParAdd calls internal::hypre_ParCSRMatrixAdd(*A, *B, &C) with three arguments, but the helper takes two and returns the matrix, so it does not compile.
reason: The fix uses the two-argument returning form, which the Add() function just above in the same diff already uses.

defect: In the new RT_R2D_FiniteElement::Project(fe,...), the scalar branch multiplies by the 2x2 adjugate, so vk[2] is never set yet is used for d < vdim (3), and the vector branch leaves out the Trans.Weight() factor on the z normal component.
reason: The same-day fix sets vk[2] = n3[2]*Weight, restricts the scaling loop to 2 and adds Weight() to the z term in these new lines (its ND_R2D part concerns older code).

defect: The new loops over all elements with a !ref_type test (destructor, PrintBoundary, both loaders) also treat freed or unused element slots (parent == -2) as leaves.
reason: The fix replaces these checks with IsLeaf(), which excludes freed elements; that the elements array holds freed slots is not visible in the diff.

defect: The new refined low-order connectivity loop indexes VertexPermutation with the running index r (p[r]) instead of the per-sub-element index k, so refined prisms get wrong or out-of-range vertex orders.
reason: The fix replaces p[r] with r - k + p[k] in this new line; indexing a per-element permutation with the cross-sub-element counter can be seen in the diff.

defect: The new tool uses HYPRE_RELEASE_VERSION/HYPRE_PACKAGE_VERSION directly as a string literal, but hypre's config header can define it unquoted, so the version detection does not compile or parse.
reason: The fix stringifies the macro with STR(); the macro's unquoted form is in HYPRE_config.h, not in the diff.

defect: The change allocates a LORSolver into a local auto pointer and a new ParBilinearForm a, and neither is ever deleted (memory leaks).
reason: The fix memory leaks stores lor_solver as a member deleted in a new destructor and adds delete a; these allocations come from this change (the other leaks the fix closes are older).

defect: The new SPD check MFEM_VERIFY(data[j+j*m] - a < 0., ...) is inverted, so the non-LAPACK Cholesky factorization aborts on every SPD matrix.
reason: The same-day fix changes < 0 to > 0 in this added line; the inverted condition can be seen in the diff.
